name: FRACTURE BOARD: Corponation Territory War
description: A physical hex-tile board game with mandatory AR overlay — players control rival corponation factions competing for district control across a miniaturized Meridian 88 map, with BCI or goggle-linked layers revealing hidden debt lines, sabotage routes, and corporate espionage cards invisible to the naked eye. Originally published by Vantablack Immersive Children's Division as a 'civic education tool,' the game was rapidly adopted by Tier 3-4 adults who recognized its uncanny accuracy in modeling real corponation behavior. Expansion packs sold separately introduce playable Shelf uprisings and regulatory capture mechanics.
story_hooks: A player notices the AR overlay is displaying live, real-time corponation transaction data rather than the game's fictional version — someone has patched the game client.
A Tier 3 gaming group is approached by a corponation fixer who wants to sponsor their tournament — with conditions about which faction must win.
A child's educational copy purchased secondhand contains a hidden AR layer with an encrypted message intended for someone else entirely.
